name: Anonymous (Navajo)
bio: The Navajo (Diné) songs in the archive belong to the Mountain Chant, a nine-night healing ceremony of the Navajo people of the American Southwest, whose songs are handed down orally by the singers and shamans who conduct it.

They were written down in 1884 by Washington Matthews (1843-1905), an army surgeon and ethnologist, from the singing of Navajo shamans, and published with his English translation in the Fifth Annual Report of the Bureau of Ethnology (1887).
